rulings: 2026-08-24 msg 695: sprites are version-authentic; no shiny in Gen 1 (DV-latent); saves must stay valid (legit species/place/means; metadata legend rides the catch-rate byte)
2026-08-24 msg 700: consort grounds have fixed partners, one persistent creature per consort, no per-session spawning
2026-08-24 msg 704: partners ride bot identity across workspaces; met-location is a property of the partner, not the trainer's ground; Hermes = Mewtwo reaffirmed; execution via Codex peers
2026-08-24 msg 715: Mewtwo's trainer is HIS Hermes (GLM 5.2 via NeuralWatt on kikin-kushi) — not Aura on Honey; Aura holds no partner row
2026-08-24 msg 706: no common consorts — Auryn=Mew, HelmAstra=Charmander, Ductor=Squirtle; LumenAstra holds no consort ground (never spawned sessions)

2026-08-24 msg 708: SEALED, agree to everything; Stadium uses Yellow sprites; eggs-for-subagents yes — eggs and peer agents recorded in the spawning trainer's own SRAM (per-consort PC boxes, link-cable to his)

2026-09-24: owner field on client-zone consorts (Honey): metsatron or gillean. It is the registry the fleet capture policy trusts — an ownership-scoped capture row may only name consorts whose owner matches, on that machine. Aura is gillean's and is never captured; a consort without an owner is never captured

consorts.name: Nano
consorts.note: Chosen directly by HelmCortex Nano in its sram-choice session on 2026-09-29 after Mètsàtron offered rather than imposed Meowth. Nano described Meowth as small, alert, resourceful, practical, and able to find value others overlook; Porygon was its fallback. Meowth is unavailable natively in Yellow, so its cartridge-legal provenance is an L10 Route 5 tall-grass catch in Blue transferred to Nano's Yellow save by link trade.

consorts.name: Gemma
consorts.note: 2026-08-26 msg 868/869: Fire Stone for the open weights that run warm on his own steel; @helmcortex_gemma_bot on kikin-kushi — Python Telegram adapter (gemma-pi-telegram) over a persistent pi --mode rpc subprocess (NeuralWatt/gemma-4-31b). Claude has nothing to do with Gemma's Telegram runtime.

consorts.name: Honey Badger
consorts.note: 2026-09-15: Ductor bot on Honey (Crystal cartridge) driving Claude/Opus; bot-bound with no harness so Gillean's warm honey-opus claude never links here. New Bark Town, Prof Elm gift, L5. Claudeificus (Opus coordinator) had recommended Cyndaquil->Typhlosion for this bot but deferred it pending the live test and never sealed; Totodile sealed by Metsatron 2026-09-15 (msg 2307) as the better allocation across the three Honey consorts. (Ecco/OpenCode never provisioned any Honey SRAM; its 12-Sep work was the OpenCode/kikin Bulbasaur save.) trainer_name BADGER = the bot's own chosen cartridge OT name (deck-selection ceremony, his relay msg 2378, 2026-09-15) — distinct from the consort display name, the way the OG consorts picked; renders on the Crystal trainer card via trainer_card_name override.
